# Provenance
`video-generator.mjs` is Alexis's `video-generator.js` copied byte-for-byte (renamed .mjs only so Node loads it as an ES module; content unchanged).
- Source: Drive batch (t641), box path `/workspace/v05/kg-batch2/video-generator.js`
- sha256: e5f33c8f6fdd0eed1c051cb1066a91f098bd68ab3170d54692a1d9ffcf9ff5bd
It needs geometry, grammar, transitions and renderer injected. Those were not in the batch, so `src/adapters.mjs` supplies minimal, clearly labelled stand-ins.
